mapper.select: SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CR.CREATED_BY, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.STATUS, CR.MAX_MEMBER, CR.IS_DEFAULT, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM WHERE CRM.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID ) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM CR LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON CR.CREATED_BY = B.BUSINESS_NO WHERE CR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'NOTICE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CR.CREATED_BY, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.STATUS, CR.MAX_MEMBER, CR.IS_DEFAULT, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER T WHERE T.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID ) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM CR JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM ON CR.ROOM_ID = CRM.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON CR.CREATED_BY = B.BUSINESS_NO WHERE CRM.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND CR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CR.CREATED_BY, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.STATUS, CR.MAX_MEMBER, CR.IS_DEFAULT, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM WHERE CRM.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID ) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM CR LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON CR.CREATED_BY = B.BUSINESS_NO WHERE CR.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND CR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM ( ROOM_ID, ROOM_NAME, ROOM_TYPE, ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, STATUS, MAX_MEMBER, IS_DEFAULT ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{roomName}, #{roomType}, #{roomDescription}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, 'ACTIVE', #{maxMember}, #{isDefault} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_ROOM SET ROOM_NAME = #{roomName}, ROOM_TYPE = #{roomType}, ROOM_DESCRIPTION = #{roomDescription}, MAX_MEMBER = #{maxMember}, IS_DEFAULT = #{isDefault} WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER ( ROOM_ID, BUSINESS_NO, JOIN_DATE ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{businessNo}, SYSDATE )
